items.author: Danae
items.text: The cake was exactly what I wanted and she was able to take a special request for flavour which I really appreciated!! Everyone couldn’t stop talking about how cute it was. Would definitely order again for a future event.

items.author: Sarah
items.text: Absolutely amazing! So easy to communicate with, and the cake was absolutely beyond my expectations!! I would recommend honeybeecakesyyc to everyone 🤍

items.author: Camille
items.text: This is the most beautiful birthday cake and cupcake assortment I have ever seen. Everything was delicious and I could not be happier with my order!

items.author: Shawhista
items.text: Such beautiful work! Timea is very good at communicating and always keeping tabs. She’s so kind and strives to make sure the customer is happy with her cakes. 5/5 would recommend ordering cakes from her! Taste is also so airy and moist!
